The native SCO2782/desA object identifies lysine decarboxylase in coelicolor A3(2); deletion and whole-cluster complementation support pathway involvement.
The original abstract directly reports that S. coelicolor desA encodes a lysine decarboxylase, distinct from the formerly predicted diaminobutyrate activity.
SCO2783/desB is natively assigned the proposed cadaverine-hydroxylase step; the comment explicitly states that this coelicolor protein had not been purified or biochemically characterized.
The directly characterized enzyme is S. sviceus SSEG_08523, expressed with a His tag. Its NADPH/NADH kinetics, FAD and tetramer observations are cross-species context, not direct coelicolor evidence.
